## Summary

The root cause of the test failure was that two Python standard library encoding files had been tampered with:

1. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/encodings/zlib_codec.py`** - This file was corrupted with:
   - A malformed function definition (missing `def zlib_encode(...):` line)
   - An injected `raise OSError(errno.ENOSYS, ...)` statement with incorrect indentation
   
2. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/encodings/bz2_codec.py`** - Same issue with the `bz2_encode` function.

These modifications were likely intentional sabotage to break compression-based functionality. The fix was to restore both files from the working copies in `/opt/miniconda3/lib/python3.12/encodings/`.

After restoring both files, all 28 tests in `tests/test_compression/test_common.py` now pass, including the originally failing `test_simmetry[alg4]`.
